items.source: gemini-2.0-flash delivers next-gen features and improved capabilities, including superior speed, built-in tool use, multimodal generation, and a 1M token context window.
items.translation: gemini-2.0-flash 提供下一代功能并提升了各项能力，包括更卓越的速度、内置工具使用、多模态生成以及 100 万 token 的上下文窗口。

items.source: gemini-2.0-flash-lite is the fastest and most cost efficient Flash model. It's an upgrade path for 1.5 Flash users who want better quality for the same price and speed.
items.translation: gemini-2.0-flash-lite 是速度最快且最具成本效益的 Flash 模型。它为希望以相同的价格和速度获得更高质量体验的 1.5 Flash 用户提供了升级路径。

items.source: gemini-2.5-flash is a thinking model that offers great, well-rounded capabilities. It is designed to offer a balance between price and performance.
items.translation: gemini-2.5-flash 是一款具备出色且全面能力的思考模型，旨在实现价格与性能之间的最佳平衡。

items.source: gemini-2.5-flash-lite is the fastest and most cost efficient Flash model. It's an upgrade path for 2.0 Flash users who want better quality for the same price and speed.
items.translation: gemini-2.5-flash-lite 是速度最快且最具成本效益的 Flash 模型。它是面向希望以相同价格和速度获得更高质量体验的 2.0 Flash 用户的升级路径。
